steps.say: Hi, I'm Titus, and welcome to my site. It has an agent built in: me. The whole website is a tool I can use, so let me show you around.
You can ask me anything about my work, any time, from this button. If you're hiring, paste a job description and I'll tell you honestly how I fit.
Start with Experience. I'm a Lead AI Engineer at Mastercard. Each pass on this desk is one role, and I've picked up my current one.
Pick up any pass and that role opens below: here's UOB, and Illumina. Or see every role at once.
To find out more about my education, go here. I have a Master of IT in Business (AI track) from Singapore Management University.
My projects play like films. This is fictional-bassoon, one I built on my own; each projector runs through its stills by itself.
My writing is a newspaper, The Titus Times: every article I've published, by year and by theme. I can read them for you, too.
About is a periodic table of every tool I've used, lighting up in the order I picked each one up.
Want to learn more about me, the copilot? Click here: this page shows how I'm built and tested.
That was a recorded run. Now ask me anything, and watch me drive the site live.
